names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 28 mai, «Sfântul Ierarh Nichita Mărturisitorul, Episcopul Calcedonului».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 28 Μαΐου, «Άγιος Νικήτας Αρχιεπίσκοπος Χαλκηδόνας», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 28. мај ст. ст., „Свети Никита исповедник, епископ халкидонски“ — Свети is not a rank, исповедник is the `confessor` this corpus puts in `types`, епископ the `bishop` it puts there and the `Bishop` in `office`, and „халкидонски“ the see, which the display name carries. Strip all four and the bare personal name is what is left. **THIS IS A FIFTH HOLDER, ENTERED ON PURPOSE AND MEASURED**: `foldchk.py` returns `nicetas-of-epirus`, `nicetas-of-medikion`, `nicetas-the-chartularius` and `nicetas-the-goth` for «Никита». **There is no fuller form to prefer**, the heading printing nothing between the name and the rank words — unlike `nicetas-the-stylite-of-pereslavl` four days earlier in this same wave, whose heading gave „Никита Столпник“ and which therefore raised no fold at all. The two cases together are the rule: the form is as full as the heading, never fuller.

The heading of the calendar’s name link 1619, «Святитель Никита Халкидонский, епископ, исповедник», with the rank word before the name and the two after it left off; the day’s own line gives the see in the genitive, «Никиты исп., еп. Халкидонского». `fk.mjs` returned NONE for «никита халкидонскии» before the write, and the bare «Никита» was deliberately not stored — this folder already holds that identical bare string as its SERBIAN form, and four other folders hold it besides.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 28 мая ст. ст. — «Прп. Никиты исп., еп. Халкидонского (IX).»

attestations.note: The identification is exact: the line gives the see and the grade «исп.» this folder already holds, and its Romanian, Greek and Serbian rows keep him on the same Julian day. `dates` WAS WRITTEN WHERE THERE WAS NONE and it is an interval and not a year: the folder had no `dates` object, the line prints «(IX)», and the life says he «жил во 2-й половине VIII века» and «скончался в начале IX века» — lived in the second half of the eighth century and died at the beginning of the ninth. The interval written is 801 to 825, the beginning of the ninth century, which is what the page states for the death, and the reign of Leo the Armenian it names, «(813 - 820)», falls inside it. NO BIRTH WAS WRITTEN. What the Russian adds and the paragraph carries: the mercy and the almsgiving, the strangers taken into his house, the care of orphans and widows and the standing up for the wronged, the open rebuking of the iconoclast heresy under Leo the Armenian and the urging of his flock to venerate the icons of Christ, of the Mother of God and of the saints, the sufferings, the torments and the exile, the healings at his relics, AND A BROTHER THE CALENDAR NAMES: «В каноне службы ему, написанном Константинопольским пресвитером Иосифом, прославляется также брат святителя Никиты - святой Игнатий» — the canon of his service, written by the Constantinopolitan presbyter Иосиф, glorifies also his brother, St Ignatius. NO `related` ROW WAS WRITTEN FOR THAT BROTHER: the calendar gives him no day, no see and no epithet, and this corpus holds a great many men of that name, so there is nobody to link to without guessing which. It is reported to the author. azbyka.ru was not read.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 28 mai — «Sfântul Ierarh Nichita Mărturisitorul, Episcopul Calcedonului»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 28ης Μαΐου — «Άγιος Νικήτας Αρχιεπίσκοπος Χαλκηδόνας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 28 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing and the same day as the folder's Romanian row. The page says he is unknown to the synaxaria and the Menaia and that his name stands in four Lavra codices, Δ 39, Θ 87, Δ 36 and Ω 147, with a service to him — a statement about the sources, and not saint.gr's asterisked refusal to vouch for an entry, which the page does not carry. The only hymn printed is a Μεγαλυνάριον, which is not an apolytikion or a kontakion, so no hymn is taken here.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 10.06.2026 (28. мај ст. ст.) — „Свети Никита исповедник, епископ халкидонски“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry, on the same menologion 28/5 the Romanian and Greek rows already carry. The heading is quoted as the Prologue prints it, without a closing full stop, as every heading of the 23 to 28 May is. **`monk` REFUSED, AND IT IS THE 16 MAY REFUSAL REPEATED EXACTLY.** „У младости одрече се света и удаљи се на подвиг монашки“ — in his youth he renounced the world and withdrew to the monastic struggle — so Монах would map to `monk`. **But `src/lib/honorific.js`’s `PRECEDENCE` returns `venerable` for `venerable` OR any of its `MONASTIC` list, and `venerable` stands above `confessor` in that list.** This folder carries `confessor` and prints *Confessor Nicetas*; adding `monk` would make the page print **Venerable Nicetas** instead, **demoting a Confessor whom two calendars name a confessor in their own headings** — doxologia’s „Sfântul Ierarh Nichita Mărturisitorul“ and this book’s „Свети Никита исповедник“. So it is not added and the monastic years are in the prose. This is the third rank refused in the wave for what it would print, after `monk` on `nicholas-the-mystikos` on 16 May — the same refusal, the same mechanism — and `virgin` on `john-vladimir` on 22 May. `confessor` and `bishop` are both corroborated outright. `office` untouched at `Bishop`. **`dates` UNTOUCHED, AND THE FOLDER STAYS UNDATED BY THE AGREEMENT OF THREE CALENDARS.** This folder has no `dates` object. doxologia gives no year, saint.gr gives none, and **the Prologue gives none either** — „Када зли Лав Јерменин устаде против икона“ is a reign and this corpus takes no year off one. **Nothing was written and the undatedness is now a reading rather than a gap.** **New here**: that he was **noticed by the elders of the Church for shining in virtue like the sun** and so raised to the hierarchical throne at Chalcedon; that as hierarch **he was especially merciful to the wretched and took great care of orphans, of widows and of the destitute**; that he **rebuked the emperor to his face and expounded the meaning of the icons**, which is a different act from standing against the persecution; and that he bore **many humiliations, afflictions and imprisonments** before the exile, and **reposed in labours and sufferings** in it. **Nobody in the entry gains a row.** Leo the Armenian is the iconoclast emperor, no calendar read for this corpus keeps him, and the elders of the Church are unnamed. `related` stays empty. No `locations`, although Chalcedon is named. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the Romanian one on this folder stays.

hymns.text: Îndreptător credinţei şi chip blândeţilor, învăţător înfrânării te-a arătat pe tine turmei tale adevărul lucrurilor. Pentru aceasta ai câştigat cu smerenia cele înalte, cu sărăcia cele bogate. Părinte Ierarhe Nichita, roagă pe Hristos Dumnezeu ca să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Ierarh Nichita Mărturisitorul, Episcopul Calcedonului; the text is the common of a hierarch with his name set in it.

english.text: A rule of faith and an image of meekness, a teacher of abstinence: so did the truth of things show thee to thy flock. Therefore thou hast gained by humility the things on high, and by poverty the things that are rich. Father and hierarch Nicetas, pray to Christ God that our souls may be saved.

hymns.text: Правило веры и образ кротости,/ воздержания учителя/ яви тя стаду твоему,/ Яже вещей истина./ Сего ради стяжал еси смирением высокая,/ нищетою богатая,/ отче Никито,/ моли Христа Бога/ спастися душам нашим.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 28 мая ст. ст., «Тропарь преподобного Никиты исповедника епископа Халкидонского», глас 4 — the common of a hierarch with his name set into it

english.text: The truth of things has shown thee to thy flock as a rule of faith, an image of meekness and a teacher of abstinence. Therefore hast thou gained the heights by humility and riches by poverty, O father Nicetas. Pray thou to Christ God that our souls may be saved.

hymns.text: Светлостию дел твоих просиял еси, преподобне,/ апостольскаго престола наследник был еси, Никите,/ и, яко солнце, облистал еси твоей пастве, отче,/ вся Божественных учений исполнь./ Темже зовем ти:/ радуйся, Халкидону удобрение.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 28 мая ст. ст., «Кондак преподобного Никиты исповедника епископа Халкидонского», глас 8 — proper to him, and it names him and his see

english.text: Thou didst shine with the brightness of thy deeds, O venerable one, and wast an heir of the apostolic throne, O Nicetas; and as a sun thou didst give light to thy flock, O father, being filled with all divine teachings. Therefore do we cry to thee: Rejoice, O adornment of Chalcedon.

death.note: The folder had no `dates` object at all. The Russian day line prints «(IX)» and its life says «Святой исповедник Никита скончался в начале IX века», that he died at the beginning of the ninth century; the same page sets his life «во 2-й половине VIII века» and names the reign of the iconoclast Leo the Armenian, «(813 - 820)», which falls inside the interval written. No year of birth appears and none was inferred.
